source: Create IR 0.1 workflow normalize_document with no inputs. Its only step has id normalize, kind tool, tool text.normalize, args {"text":" A  B "}. The workflow output text references steps.normalize.text. Do not add retry, timeout or conditions.

Create IR 0.1 workflow save_document. Required input body is a string with no default. Step clean uses kind tool, tool text.normalize, args.text from inputs.body. Then step save uses kind tool, tool files.write_text, args.path exactly cleaned.txt and args.text from steps.clean.text. The only workflow output is text from steps.clean.text. Do not add other steps, conditions, retry or timeout.
Do the usual thing to the document and put it in the normal place. I have not specified what the usual transformation or destination is.
